name: qa-time
description: Time and timezone testing: fake clocks across runtimes, DST transitions, leap seconds, and timezone test matrices built from a codebase's date handling. Fake clocks cover freezegun, Jest and Sinon fake timers, timecop, java.time.Clock, .NET TimeProvider and libfaketime. A critic agent (time-handling-critic) flags naive now() calls and DST-unsafe arithmetic.
